legalBasis.rule: TKG 2021 § 165(3), strictly necessary storage for a service explicitly requested by the user

storage.purpose: Remember the accepted Terms and Privacy Notice version so the user is not asked on every visit.
storage.duration: 365 days, or until the user clears site data
storage.trigger: Written only after the user checks the terms box or an existing valid first-party acceptance is restored.

storage.purpose: Keep the collaboration/cloud session that the user explicitly enabled.
storage.duration: Until sign-out, session expiry, account/data deletion, or browser site-data deletion
storage.trigger: Created only after a user starts a Supabase-backed sign-in or cloud/collaboration flow.

storage.purpose: Store credentials and legal metadata, requested feature caches, and the user's local stats history.
storage.duration: Until sign-out/data deletion or browser site-data deletion; feature records follow the retention controls described in the Privacy Notice.
storage.trigger: The empty database schema is initialized at startup; records are added only by a user-requested feature, sign-in, or terms acceptance.

storage.owner: App recovery, authentication, compare-room, and stats components
storage.purpose: Complete the current navigation/authentication flow, prevent reload loops, and keep a chosen comparison point for this tab only.
storage.duration: Current browser tab session; individual flow values are removed when consumed
storage.trigger: Written only when the corresponding user flow runs or a broken app chunk needs one recovery reload.

storage.purpose: Deliver and safely update the same-origin application shell and static assets.
storage.duration: Managed by the service worker and removed when site data or the service worker is cleared
storage.trigger: Production application visit; no API response, Spotify image, analytics, or cross-origin resource is configured for caching.

storage.purpose: Install/update the application and, only after opt-in, deliver requested notifications.
storage.duration: Until site-data/service-worker deletion; push subscriptions last until disabled or invalidated
storage.trigger: The worker registers in production; Web Push subscription requires the user's notification action and browser permission.
